subject: or_legislature/2025R1/SB1192
title: Provides that the Water Resources Director may not forcibly convert a hydroelectric water right whose holder has ceased generating electricity on instruction from the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission if certain other criteria are met.
headline: SB 1192 did not pass

claims.text: SB 1192 was introduced in the Senate on March 20, 2025.
